upgrade.label: On-Grid Upgrade
upgrade.description: Upgrade existing solar system to higher capacity

pricing.note: Customer price = pack market rate + swap delta + roof add-on; transport beyond base km is a separate customer extra (D3/D4/D6).

futureUpgrade.note: Panels at panelSize, inverter/structure/DB/cables/meter at systemSize (owner Q7). PH edits pairs; market rate key = <systemType>_<tier>[_<bat>]_up<systemSize>. Seeded pairs are proposals — PH confirms.
